description: Kivy application implementing a chat messenger interface with custom message widgets, message handling, and UI layout.

classes.name: MessengerApp
classes.description: Main application class managing message data, UI interactions, and message display logic.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Loads the UI layout from the KV string.

methods.name: add_message
methods.description: Adds a new message to the messages list with specified text, side, and color.

methods.name: update_message_size
methods.description: Updates the size and text size of a message based on its texture size and maximum width.

methods.name: focus_textinput
methods.description: Sets focus to the provided TextInput widget.

methods.name: send_message
methods.description: Handles sending a message, clearing input, adding message, focusing input, scheduling an answer, and scrolling.

methods.name: scroll_bottom
methods.description: Animates scrolling to the bottom of the message list.
